This prompt turns the public evidence in the [EBS Hub profile checker](profile-check.html), together with your own judgement, into a draft you can review. It does not update Pure or any other profile.

## How to use it

1. Open the profile checker and choose your name.
2. Copy your current biography, keywords, recent outputs, visible projects or activities, and useful links into the marked evidence section.
3. Answer the four short questions in the prompt.
4. Copy the complete prompt below into Gemini or another AI assistant.
5. Check every claim before pasting any approved text into Pure.

After reviewing the draft, return to the [workshop slides](index.html) or open [Monash myResearch](https://www.monash.edu/myResearch/home) to edit your profile.
